description: Detail for one concept: meta plus current member securities with latest snapshots. Use after `concepts_list`. Pass `kind=industry` for a Shenwan industry id — a dimension mismatch returns 404, same as an unknown id. Members carry `close` / `pct_change` plus `price` (identical to `close`, the name `quote` / `scan` use for the last price). The response echoes `kind`; carry it with the id. Members are ordered by `main_net_in` desc by default (who is drawing money in); change with `member_sort` / `member_order`.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

kind.description: Dimension: concept (hot-theme library, default), base (broad base labels), or industry. All use independent chain-linked equal-weight indices with base 1000. A stored theme membership alone does not establish current trading activity; use concept_tags for current status.

member_sort.description: Order members by: main_net_in (default) / pct_change / amount / weight; members missing the key go last

name: concepts_show
